text: 爱尔兰将降低燃料相关税费，作为一系列能源措施的一部分，以帮助选民并平息今年早些时候升级为抗议活动的民怨。政府将降低家庭取暖用油和天然气的碳税，并将燃油消费税的临时减免延长至2027年2月底。财政部公布了一揽子个人所得税方案，还宣布上调最低工资、提高“购房援助”申领额度，并增加租金税收抵免等措施。
text_en: Ireland will cut fuel-related taxes as part of a series of energy measures to help voters and calm public anger that escalated into protests earlier this year. The government will reduce the carbon tax on home heating oil and natural gas, and extend the temporary excise cut on motor fuels through the end of February 2027. The Finance Ministry unveiled a package of personal income tax measures and also announced an increase in the minimum wage, a higher threshold for the Help to Buy scheme, and an expanded rent tax credit, among other measures.
